title: The Diploma and the Order
subtitle: Dr. Taki & Dr. Touitou are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Taki has just earned his doctorate in dental medicine. His dream: to open his own practice. But he discovers that a diploma is not enough...

To practice legally, he must be registered with the National Order of Dental Surgeons.

Between registration, regional and national councils, elections, dues, and disciplinary sanctions... the path is fraught with obstacles.

A missed registration, a forgotten declaration, and illegal practice awaits him.

The regularity of his practice, his credibility, his future rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Taki has just earned his doctorate in dental medicine. He discovers the basics of registration with the Order, access conditions, deadlines, and the fundamental missions of the ONMD.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou deepen their knowledge of elections, Regional and National Councils, dues, and disciplinary sanctions. They must master professional regulatory law to practice with peace of mind.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou are faced with complex situations: council functioning, attributions, dues. They must handle registration requests and the day-to-day affairs of the Order.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou handle disciplinary disputes: complaints, procedures, appeals, sanctions. They must defend the ethics and regularity of the profession.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou become references in professional regulatory law. They train young dentists in the importance of the Order and professional ethics.
chapters.expert2: After years of commitment and service to the Order, Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of skills in professional regulatory law and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Taki has laid the foundations of registration with the Order. But the road ahead is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Elections and councils are mastered. Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou are ready to commit.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: The life of the Order is mastered. Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Disciplinary disputes are mastered. Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Ordinal commitment has become a key skill. Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Taki and Dr. Touitou have accomplished their mission. The Order is the heart of professional regulation.
